title: fix(app-shell): keep the dataset seed's count measure on the first base-object pick (objectui#12848)
body:
Fixes #12848
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`objectChangePatch` in `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx` reset `measures: []` on every base-object change. On a new dataset the draft holds no `measures`; the create seed's `count` is merged in only at save, by `buildCreateModeBody` (`{ ...seed, ...draft }`). The first base-object pick therefore wrote `measures: []` into the draft, and that overwrote the seed's `count`. Every dataset created by open, pick an object, save was stored with no measures.

The patch now takes the draft being re-based as a third argument and applies one rule. The hint under the base-object picker now states that rule.

## The rule implemented

- **A measure that names no field is kept.** That is a measure with no `field` (or only the `'*'` row wildcard), no measure-scoped `filter` (its keys are fields) and no `derived` spec. This is the row count: it means the same on any object.
- **Every other measure is cleared**: one that names a `field`, one with a `filter`, and every `derived` measure. A derived measure combines other measures, and in every measured case at least one of them is filtered or names a field (`won_rate` combines `won_count`, which has a filter, and `deal_count`). Keeping it would leave a reference to a cleared measure, which the spec refuses as a reference to an unknown measure.
- **First pick (empty value to an object):** the draft holds no `measures`, so the patch writes none and the save keeps the seed's `count`.
- **Move (object A to object B):** `include`, `dimensions` and `filter` are cleared as before. From `measures`, only the measures that name no field are kept.
- **Same object:** a no-op that only sets `object`, as before.
- **Called with no draft (the two-argument form):** nothing is kept (`measures: []`), as before. The existing `objectChangePatch` pin in `DatasetDefaultInspector.test.tsx` is unchanged.

Shapes measured: the spec seed is `{ name: 'count', aggregate: 'count' }`, with no `field`. Every hotcrm dataset (account, contact, lead, task, event, product, case) and every app-showcase dataset carries a plain count with no field and no filter. They also carry field-bound sums and averages, counts with a `filter` (case, chart-gallery, revenue-pulse) and `derived` ratios over a filtered count.

`createBody.ts` is unchanged: the patch alone fixes the saved body.

## The base-object hint

The hint under the picker (`engine.inspector.dataset.baseObjectChangeHint` in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`) used to say a change clears the dataset's measures. It now reads:

- en: "Changing the base object clears its dimensions, field measures, joins & filters; a row count is kept."
- zh: 「更改基础对象会清空其维度、字段度量、关联与筛选；行计数会保留。」

Those are the only two rows of that key, and nothing else in `i18n.ts` changes. The objectui#10586 string pin (`inspectorStrings.i18n-10586.test.tsx`) lists every en string the dataset inspector renders, word for word; its one entry for this hint now holds the new en copy.

## Live before and after

The backend was hotcrm `objectstack dev --fresh` on :4712, with the console run from this worktree on :5712. Steps: open a new dataset, type a Label and a Name, pick Account (`crm_account`), Save.

- `main` (`8106db1`): PUT body `measures: []`. The reread draft (`GET /api/v1/meta/dataset/main_probe?state=draft`) has `"measures":[]`, and the reopened designer shows Measures 0 and "Add a measure".
- This branch: PUT body `measures: [{"name":"count","aggregate":"count"}]`. The reread draft has the same value, and the reopened designer shows Measures 1 (`count`), with a preview Count of 9.

In the designer itself, right after the first pick, the Measures section reads 0 on both `main` and this branch. In create mode the draft never holds the seed's measures: they are merged only in the save body, so `count` appears once the saved item reopens. The live run was taken at `91d0bc6`, before the hint commit; the hint is pinned by tests.

## Screenshots (light)

- Branch, after save (reopened, Measures 1 = count): https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/23700d5eb6d06938ca6de04a987a11a9a2e6d643/docs/design/findings/12848/branch-after-save.png?raw=true
- Main, after save (reopened, Measures 0): https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/23700d5eb6d06938ca6de04a987a11a9a2e6d643/docs/design/findings/12848/main-after-save.png?raw=true
- Branch, after the first pick: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/23700d5eb6d06938ca6de04a987a11a9a2e6d643/docs/design/findings/12848/branch-after-first-pick.png?raw=true
- Main, after the first pick: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/23700d5eb6d06938ca6de04a987a11a9a2e6d643/docs/design/findings/12848/main-after-first-pick.png?raw=true

## Tests (at `524d225`)

New file `DatasetDefaultInspector.firstPickKeepsCount-12848.test.tsx`, 6 tests:

- The real `MetadataResourceEditPage` and the real dataset designer run over a recording in-memory `MetadataClient` server; the `/meta/types` entry carries the spec seed and the dataset JSON schema. Open, pick an object, save: the body carries the seed's measures. Open, pick A, pick B, save: the body still carries them.
- CONTROL: a move from A to B clears `include`, `dimensions`, `filter`, the field-bound measure, the filtered count and the derived ratio. It keeps the plain count and the `'*'` count.
- CONTROL: selecting the same object returns only `{ object }`.
- The hint renders the new copy in en-US and zh-CN.

Ablation: each mutation was run against the committed fix and restored with `git checkout HEAD` (blob hash compared to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):

- Write `measures: []` when the draft has none: both page tests red.
- Keep no measures on a move: the move CONTROL red.
- Keep every measure: the move CONTROL red.
- Remove the same-object guard: the same-object CONTROL red.
- Restore the old hint copy in en and zh: both hint pins red.

Gates, all exit 0 at `524d225`:

- vitest over every inspector test, `createBody.test.ts`, `createBody.seedPlaceholders-12810.test.ts`, `ResourceEditPage.seedPlaceholder-12810`, `ResourceEditPage.nameSurvivesLabel-12680`, `ResourceEditPage.servedDraftTakenAsIs-10765` and `createConformance`: 187 files, 2532 passed and 1 skipped.
- `type-check` and `build` for `@object-ui/app-shell`.
- eslint on the four touched source and test files: 0 errors. The 4 warnings were there before this change.
- `check:i18n-keys`; `check:i18n-drift` (every changed en designer row is followed by its zh row); `check-changeset-presence`.
